info.title: Eluno Store Studio
info.description:
## Two clients, one backend
The frontend at `/` and this Swagger UI call the same FastAPI services and share the same records.
You can complete the whole demonstration here without opening the frontend.

**Route through the demo:** login → source customer/catalog/stock → prepare → complete → detail → refund prepare/complete → source report.

**Data ownership:** Shopify mock = customers, catalog, stock, orders and refunds; SMT mock = prescriptions and staff; local configuration = offers and GST; SQLite = saved quotes, invoice series, financial state, sessions, clinical additions, cash and audit.

**Important:** this is a supplied Shopify-shaped mock, not a live Shopify store. All amounts named `_paise` are integer paise. Read source inventory before and after completion to prove the stock effect.

For every operation, expand the description, inspect the request **Schema**, then inspect the returned **Response body**. Copy returned checkout/refund IDs into later steps. Under detail, compare `quote.order_payload` with `order`.

get.description: Reads SQLite only. Shows which financial stage finished, external references and completion duration stored directly on the checkout row; this does not fetch the source order.

403.description: Role/store access or CSRF check rejected the request.

post.description: Reads customer, variants, billing location and stock from Shopify; staff and wearer prescriptions from SMT/local clinical records. A wearer can bill frame/lens pairs, ready-to-wear or prescription sunglasses, or lens-only pairs through lens_only_variant_ids. Every lens is validated against that wearer's prescription and carried on its Shopify line; standalone lens pairs have no frame pair_ref and do not affect frame inventory. Calculates effective-date HSN GST and discounts from local data. No coupon is applied unless selected_offer_id is supplied; then the server rechecks dates and cart/customer conditions and applies only that coupon. No manager discount is applied unless both override_bps and reason_code are provided with an authorized identity. Manager discount is exclusive of a coupon. Saves quote/order_payload in SQLite and reserves a store invoice number. Returns checkout_id. It does NOT charge payment, create a Shopify order or reserve physical inventory.

post.summary: 4. Confirm payment and create the source order
post.description: For UPI/card: POST terminal /terminal/charges, persist charge reference, then POST Shopify orders.json with the saved lines, discounts, tax, location, invoice/checkout metadata and a successful payment transaction. Shopify creates the order and decrements tracked stock at that store. Cash and zero-charge remakes use their own local payment handling. A successful repeat returns the same order. An uncertain result is blocked for investigation.

prescriptions.title: Prescriptions
prescriptions.description: Source plus locally authored records. Not all are current; sale preparation chooses the latest unexpired record.

id.title: Id
id.description: Source customer ID; use as stable identity, not as a phone number.

override_bps.title: Override Bps
override_bps.description: Manager-entered discount in basis points (500 = 5%). Applies exactly as entered and exclusively of other offers; requires manager permission and a reason.

selected_offer_id.title: Selected Offer Id
selected_offer_id.description: Optional offer_id from offers.json. Only this offer is applied after server validation. Omit to apply no coupon discount.

store_code.title: Store Code
store_code.description: Store where the clinician entered this prescription; the frontend supplies the selected store.

valid_until.title: Valid Until
valid_until.description: Today through two years ahead; validated by the clinical endpoint.

date.title: Date
date.description: Issued date or timestamp; used when selecting the latest valid prescription.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Existing wearer phone; their own latest complete valid prescription is used.

variant_ids.title: Variant Ids
variant_ids.description: Selected frame and lens variant IDs. Every optical frame needs exactly one paired lens. Sunglasses can be ready-to-wear or paired with one prescription lens.

lens_only_variant_ids.title: Lens Only Variant Ids
lens_only_variant_ids.description: Lens pairs sold without frames. Each item is one lens-pair variant and is validated against this wearer's current prescription.

frame_only_variant_ids.title: Frame Only Variant Ids
frame_only_variant_ids.description: Explicit frame-only purchases. These frames have no lens or prescription attached; move a frame into variant_ids with its lens to sell a complete prescription pair.

checkout_id.description: Copy this into the complete and detail endpoints.
checkout_id.title: Checkout Id

invoice_no.description: Reserved local per-store invoice number; not a Shopify order number.
invoice_no.title: Invoice No

total_paise.description: Exact amount to confirm. Divide by 100 for INR.
total_paise.title: Total Paise

status.description: draft: no payment or source order has been created.
status.title: Status

frame_restocked_on_shopify_success.description: Intended behavior on completion; prepare has NOT restocked anything.
frame_restocked_on_shopify_success.title: Frame Restocked On Shopify Success

quote.description: Persisted quote. order_payload is the order body prepared for Shopify; lines show each wearer, HSN and tax. Completion adds transactions before sending.
quote.title: Quote

order.description: Live GET of the source Shopify mock order after completion, including line IDs, transactions and refunds; null before an order exists.
order.title: Order

refunds.description: Local durable refund attempts, including prepared payload_json and source IDs.
refunds.title: Refunds

invoice.description: Immutable issued invoice in SQLite; null for an unpaid draft.
invoice.title: Invoice

refund_events.description: Append-only refund state changes, actor references and synchronization times.
refund_events.title: Refund Events

tags.name: 00 · Access
tags.description: Start with POST /auth/login. Swagger itself is sufficient; no frontend login is needed. Use provisioned credentials. The browser stores the HttpOnly cookie and Swagger automatically attaches the session CSRF token.

tags.name: 01 · Read source data
tags.description: Read customer/catalog/inventory before quoting. Shopify provides commercial data; prescriptions and staff come from the store-tool mock. Offers and GST rules are local configuration.

tags.name: 02 · Quote — no payment
tags.description: Validate inputs, calculate offers and tax, then persist a quote and reserve an invoice number locally. No charge or Shopify order yet.

tags.name: 03 · Confirm and inspect
tags.description: Payment confirmation is a separate write. Inspect the saved quote and source order to explain exactly what came back from Shopify.

tags.name: 04 · Refund and reconcile
tags.description: Preview first, then refund payment and write the source refund. Uncertain writes require inspection; they are not blindly repeated.

tags.name: 05 · Source reports
tags.description: Read Shopify orders/refunds back to produce reconciled reports. The new report uses IST and refund-event dates; the original day-end contract is preserved.

tags.name: 06 · Store operations
tags.description: Clinical entry, remakes, cash drawer, saved carts, register and audit APIs use the same permissions as the UI.

tags.name: 07 · Demo evidence
tags.description: Coverage, local performance evidence and basic application health.
